description: This file defines API route handlers for managing categories and boards within a team, including creation, updating, deletion, reordering, hiding, and unhiding of boards and categories in a project management application.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API struct that contains methods for handling category and board related API requests.

methods.name: registerCategoriesRoutes
methods.description: Registers HTTP routes for category and board management endpoints.

methods.name: handleCreateCategory
methods.description: Handles creation of a new category within a team.

methods.name: handleGetUserCategoryBoards
methods.description: Retrieves the user's category boards for a team.

methods.name: handleUpdateCategoryBoard
methods.description: Sets or updates the category of a specific board.

methods.name: handleHideBoard
methods.description: Hides a board for the user.

methods.name: handleUnhideBoard
methods.description: Unhides a previously hidden board for the user.
